title: The Global Workforce Just Hit An All-Time High
hook: 3.7 billion people work now. Fewer depend on each one.
closing: More hands, fewer mouths, bigger cities. Do the math.
question: Rather live rural or urban?

segments.say: The global labor force grew to 3.7 billion people by 2025, the biggest working-age population ever.
Each worker today supports far fewer dependents than decades ago.
Most of that growth landed in cities -- the world is now 58 percent urban.
